questions.question: Which country won the UEFA European Championship in 1992?
questions.explanation: Denmark entered the finals as late replacements and defeated Germany 2–0.

questions.question: Which country hosted UEFA Euro 1992?
questions.explanation: The finals took place in Sweden, including the final in Gothenburg.

questions.question: Which club did Liverpool defeat in the 2005 Champions League final?
questions.explanation: Liverpool came back from 3–0 down to beat AC Milan on penalties.

questions.question: Who was Liverpool's goalkeeper in the 2005 Champions League final?
questions.explanation: Dudek made decisive saves in the penalty shoot-out.

questions.question: Who scored Liverpool's equalising goal to make it 3–3 in the 2005 Champions League final?
questions.explanation: Alonso scored Liverpool's third goal after his penalty was initially saved.

questions.question: Who won the Formula One drivers' world championship in 2009?
questions.explanation: Button won the drivers' championship for Brawn GP.

questions.question: Who finished second in the 2009 Formula One drivers' championship?
questions.explanation: Vettel was runner-up to Jenson Button.

questions.question: Which film won Best Picture at the 2001 Academy Awards?
questions.explanation: Gladiator won Best Picture, and Russell Crowe won Best Actor.

questions.question: Which film won all 11 Academy Awards for which it was nominated at the 2004 ceremony?
options: Master and Commander: The Far Side of the World
The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King
questions.correct_answer: The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King
questions.explanation: The Return of the King achieved an 11-for-11 clean sweep.

questions.question: For which film did Charlize Theron win Best Actress at the 2004 Academy Awards?
questions.explanation: Theron won Best Actress for her role in Monster.

questions.question: Which film won the Animated Feature Oscar at the 2004 Academy Awards?
questions.explanation: Finding Nemo won the Animated Feature Film category.

questions.question: Which album won Album of the Year at the 1978 Grammy Awards?
options: Out of the Blue — Electric Light Orchestra
questions.explanation: Fleetwood Mac won for Rumours, ahead of several celebrated albums.

questions.question: Which song won Record of the Year at the 1978 Grammy Awards?
options: You Light Up My Life — Debby Boone
Go Your Own Way — Fleetwood Mac
questions.explanation: The Eagles' Hotel California was named Record of the Year.

questions.question: Which album won Album of the Year at the 2012 Grammy Awards?
questions.explanation: Adele's second studio album, 21, took the award.

questions.question: Which act won Best New Artist at the 2012 Grammy Awards?
questions.explanation: Indie folk act Bon Iver won the Best New Artist award.

questions.question: Which album won Album of the Year at the 2014 Grammy Awards?
options: Good Kid, M.A.A.D City — Kendrick Lamar
questions.explanation: Daft Punk won the award with Random Access Memories.

questions.question: Which song won Song of the Year at the 2014 Grammy Awards?
options: Just Give Me a Reason — P!nk
Locked Out of Heaven — Bruno Mars
questions.explanation: Lorde and Joel Little received Song of the Year for Royals.

questions.question: In which year did Queen Victoria become monarch of the United Kingdom?
questions.explanation: Victoria became queen after the death of William IV in 1837.

questions.question: What was the name of Queen Victoria's husband?
questions.explanation: Victoria married Prince Albert in 1840.

questions.question: In which year was the Rosetta Stone discovered by French soldiers in Egypt?
questions.explanation: The stone was discovered in 1799 and helped scholars decipher hieroglyphs.

questions.question: Which language appears alongside hieroglyphic and Demotic scripts on the Rosetta Stone?
questions.explanation: The decree is preserved in three scripts, including Greek.

questions.question: In which modern country is the ancient site of Machu Picchu?
questions.explanation: Machu Picchu is an Inca site in Peru.

questions.question: Which civilisation built Machu Picchu in the fifteenth century?
questions.explanation: The Inca constructed Machu Picchu in the 15th century.

questions.question: Which Mughal emperor commissioned the Taj Mahal?
questions.explanation: Shah Jahan commissioned the mausoleum in memory of Mumtaz Mahal.

questions.question: The Taj Mahal stands beside which river?
questions.explanation: The Taj Mahal stands on the right bank of the Yamuna River in Agra.

questions.question: Which is the largest living species of lizard?
questions.explanation: Komodo dragons can reach around three metres in length.

questions.question: Which metal has been found concentrated along the cutting edges of Komodo dragon teeth?
questions.explanation: Researchers found iron-rich enamel along the teeth's serrated edges.

questions.question: In which arcade game did Mario first appear, under the name Jumpman?
questions.explanation: Mario debuted as Jumpman in the 1981 Donkey Kong game.

questions.question: Which Nintendo designer created the original 1981 Donkey Kong arcade game?
questions.explanation: Shigeru Miyamoto designed Donkey Kong for Nintendo.

questions.question: For which effect was Einstein specifically recognised by the 1921 Nobel Prize in Physics?
questions.explanation: Einstein's Nobel citation particularly recognised his explanation of the photoelectric effect.
